parts.name: bottle shell

physics.Basic_description: Translucent light blue cylindrical body with horizontal ridges, made of flexible plastic.
physics.Functional_description: Main container for holding liquid contents.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the cylindrical body from the sides with a parallel jaw gripper.
physics.reason: Thin-walled blow-molded plastic container enclosing air/liquid volume.

parts.description: Translucent light blue cylindrical body with horizontal ridges, made of flexible plastic.
parts.function: Main container for holding liquid contents.

parts.name: front label

physics.Basic_description: Small rectangular label adhered to the side of the bottle.
physics.Grasped_description: Too thin and flat to grasp effectively; avoid contact.
physics.reason: Thin sheet material, effectively solid relative to its scale.

parts.description: Small rectangular label adhered to the side of the bottle.

parts.name: liquid fill

physics.Basic_description: Internal volume representing the fluid content inside the bottle.
physics.Functional_description: The substance being stored and dispensed.
physics.reason: Fluid fills the internal cavity, modeled as a solid volume for mass estimation.

parts.description: Internal volume representing the fluid content inside the bottle.
parts.function: The substance being stored and dispensed.

parts.name: collar shell

physics.Basic_description: White ribbed screw cap or collar at the top of the bottle.
physics.Functional_description: Secures the dispensing mechanism to the bottle neck.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the ribbed sides to twist or hold steady.
physics.reason: Injection molded plastic cap with internal threads, hollow interior.

parts.description: White ribbed screw cap or collar at the top of the bottle.
parts.function: Secures the dispensing mechanism to the bottle neck.

parts.name: pump head shell

physics.Basic_description: Top actuator component of the dispensing mechanism (mapped to collar area in this simple model).
physics.Functional_description: User interface for dispensing liquid (if pump) or sealing (if cap).
physics.Grasped_description: Press down or grasp depending on mechanism type.
physics.reason: Molded plastic component, typically hollow to save material.

parts.description: Top actuator component of the dispensing mechanism (mapped to collar area in this simple model).
parts.function: User interface for dispensing liquid (if pump) or sealing (if cap).

parts.name: dip tube

physics.Basic_description: Thin white tube extending from the bottom of the bottle.
physics.Functional_description: Draws liquid from the bottom of the container to the outlet.
physics.Grasped_description: Too thin and flexible to grasp reliably; avoid.
physics.reason: Extruded plastic tubing is inherently hollow to allow fluid flow.

parts.description: Thin white tube extending from the bottom of the bottle.
parts.function: Draws liquid from the bottom of the container to the outlet.

parts.name: spout shell

physics.Basic_description: Small nozzle or attachment point on the side/top for dispensing.
physics.Functional_description: Directs the flow of liquid out of the bottle.
physics.Grasped_description: Small feature, not suitable for primary grasping.
physics.reason: Molded plastic nozzle with a channel for fluid, hollow structure.

parts.description: Small nozzle or attachment point on the side/top for dispensing.
parts.function: Directs the flow of liquid out of the bottle.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)
simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained
